title: M5 Max h3.c 512-square 5-second paired observation

measurement_scope.portable_harness: Adapted after these runs; original runner and harness digests retained, not claimed byte-identical.

recipe.prompt: A red fox walks through fresh snow in a pine forest. Medium tracking shot, natural winter light, realistic fur, soft footsteps and wind.

shape.shape_evidence: source-derived h3_host.c; text/packed tokens not logged by pinned CLI

model.weights: Not redistributed; approximately 144 GB original checkpoint

geometry_note: 9472 video + 414 stereo-audio + 28 prompt rows = 9914 logical packed rows. Prompt rows were checked separately with the pinned CPU tokenizer; not per-operation runtime trace.

progress_limitations: Receipt timestamps are recorded after pipe read and local log flush; they are not producer or device timestamps.
Differences include CPU encoding, synchronization, dispatch and observer scheduling/I/O delay; delay error is not bounded.
Step 0 is excluded descriptively. Remaining steps are not proven compilation-free and are not independent repeated identical inputs.
Coalesced boundaries and intervals touching them are ambiguous, excluded from the summary; zero receipt deltas are not zero execution time.
Completed enqueue steps follow synchronization for this fixed recipe; the final latent readback/unpack follows enqueue completion and is excluded.
Profile phase totals overlap. Root-GPU counters and receipt intervals are distinct; neither provides per-operation device attribution.
